name: Record east-based El Niño
headline: ENSO Longitude Index 191.5°E, the easternmost on record: an east-based event like 1982–83 and 1997–98.

sections.The setup: Weekly Niño 3.4 +3.3 °C (7 Oct), relative +2.4; Niño 1+2 +5.2; heat content +3.39 °C; official ONI (Jul–Sep) +2.16.
sections.The trigger: ENSO Longitude Index 191.5°E, the easternmost on record: an east-based event like 1982–83 and 1997–98.
sections.What amplified it: California: >90% odds of a wetter-than-average winter, peak Dec–Mar (Swain). Quoted "ONI +3.3" is a weekly value, not the official ONI.
sections.Climate signal: California emergency proclamation cites a study finding El Niño events now 36% stronger than pre-industrial.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
